main.description: A correction to a published puzzle -- e.g. a clarified clue, a typo fix, or a revised accepted-answer list. Kept as its own record rather than a silent edit to the puzzle, since revisions typically need distinct presentation to solvers who already started (and potentially a notification), not just a quietly-updated puzzle.

authorDid.description: Usually the puzzle's own author. Kept explicit rather than assumed, since a future structured event could have judges or administrators issuing corrections who aren't the original author.

text.description: Explanation of what changed and why, shown to solvers.

revisedClues.description: The corrected clue(s), matched to the puzzle's own clues by id. Omitted if this erratum doesn't change any clue (e.g. a body-only correction).
